dataset.description:
The raw input datasets were retrieved from the Eurostat API and stored as CSV snapshot files in the "data/raw/" directory of the Github Repository to ensure reproducibility and version stability of the analysis. The datasets cover EU member states for the years 2014–2022 and include both environmental protection investment indicators and macroeconomic indicators.
The raw datasets are preserved in their original tabular structure. Standard preprocessing steps such as cleaning, integration, and transformation into the relational database schema are applied during the analysis workflow.
